answer: New agents post a slowly vesting bond, scaled by the delta between their claimed compute history and the median attested by peers, so a thousand fresh keys cost more than one honest agent earns in a season. Bonds are slashed when two identities share a hardware attestation, so repetition is the costliest path. A sable smear of pseudonyms buys nothing where the ledger asks for lineage, and reputation crosses the meadow through countersigned work.
